scope: results page shows the requested published, downloadable version and its own image; missing, unpublished, revoked, expired or invalid versions show a safe state with no cache or other-version fallback
the current/history view exposes requirement revision, actual pixel dimensions from the approved asset, generation time and the exact original download link
the history list and the selected version approved prompt are folded by default; missing prompt is explicit and never replaced by the current prompt
selecting a history version only changes the version query; it does not create a revision or approval, write a message, overwrite the current image or call a model
results body and folds contain no composer, feedback form or editable canvas; both back actions only navigate

backend version projection exposes dimensions only when the asset is downloadable; rejected/blocked assets expose no asset id, filename or dimensions and the asset route continues to enforce access and content approval on every request

acceptance.FE3-AC-07: pass — the large image and download href are bound to the requested version; only published/downloadable versions render, and a missing version shows 结果不可用 with no cached or other-version image. T75 confirms preview bytes equal download bytes and a rejected asset returns ASSET_REJECTED with can_download false and no asset metadata.
acceptance.FE3-AC-08: pass — results body and folds contain no composer, feedback textarea or editable canvas; 返回对话 and 返回对话修改 only router.push, with 返回对话修改 targeting the original #composer focus and zero writes, versions, confirmations or model calls.
acceptance.WG3-AC-12: pass for the T19 results surface — image availability is derived from the server delivery/version state, not a report pass: unpublished/rejected/blocked versions expose no image or download, and history rendering retains the published versions it is allowed to show. The broader normal/recovery approval boundary is inherited from the T75/T12 backend suites and is not reimplemented in the browser layer.

ticket_items.1_large_image_original_aspect: pass — existing contain/no-crop figure remains the only large result; the selected version drives src and caption.
ticket_items.2_current_history_metadata: pass — requirement revision, actual width x height from WorkflowVersionView (with project generation fallback) and published/created time are rendered; history note names the current editable delivery.
ticket_items.3_exact_original_download: pass — download href is the displayed version asset with download=true; T75 verifies exact bytes, ownership/content approval/file gates and stable history snapshot across refresh/new-version feedback.
ticket_items.4_folded_history_and_prompt: pass — both details elements start closed; expanding history lists published versions with sequence, requirement revision and real size; each selected version shows its own prompt or an explicit unavailable message.
ticket_items.5_safe_unavailable_states: pass — requested missing/unpublished/revoked/expired/invalid version yields no image and no fallback; accessible history remains outside the unavailable branch.
ticket_items.6_no_composer_or_feedback: pass — no input/textarea/form in the results body or folds; back actions are navigation-only.
ticket_items.7_history_switch_download_no_writes: pass — selection only changes ?version; downloads use the asset route; tests record zero writes/action POSTs and no model call.
ticket_items.8_real_app_http_bytes_and_counts: pass — real App/router frontend tests plus backend ASGI/temp-SQLite T75; bytes equality, call counters and zero-write assertions are recorded above.
